test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

Have the archivists digitized the medieval manuscripts yet?

options.text: Were the medieval manuscripts digitized by the archivists yet?
Have the medieval manuscripts been digitized by the archivists yet?
Are the medieval manuscripts being digitized by the archivists yet?
Had the medieval manuscripts been digitized by the archivists yet?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Have the archivists digitized the medieval manuscripts yet?"
 
• To convert an interrogative sentence to passive voice, keep the auxiliary verb at the beginning, but match it to the new subject.
 
• Place the new subject "the medieval manuscripts" after the auxiliary verb "Have".
 
• Change the active verb form "digitized" to "been digitized" (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the archivists."
 
• Ensure the adverb "yet" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Have the medieval manuscripts been digitized by the archivists yet?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Were the medieval manuscripts digitized by the archivists yet?" – Incorrect tense (simple past passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"Are the medieval manuscripts being digitized by the archivists yet?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"Had the medieval manuscripts been digitized by the archivists yet?" – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
